title: Unlawful Sexual Relations

questions.question: Whose practices were the Israelites commanded not to follow?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:3 (ESV): "You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt... nor shall you do as they do in the land of Canaan."

questions.question: The phrase "uncover nakedness" is a euphemism for what?
questions.explanation: Context of Leviticus 18 clearly refers to sexual prohibitions.

questions.question: Was it lawful to marry two sisters at the same time?
options: No, while one is still alive (as a rival wife)
questions.correctAnswer: No, while one is still alive (as a rival wife)
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:18 (ESV): "And you shall not take a woman as a rival wife to her sister... while her sister is yet alive."

questions.question: What practice regarding children was forbidden?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:21 (ESV): "You shall not give any of your children to offer them to Molech."

questions.question: What is the command regarding lying with a male as with a woman?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:22 (ESV): "You shall not lie with a male as with a woman; it is an abomination."

questions.question: Is sexual activity with animals permitted?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:23 (ESV): "You shall not lie with any animal... it is perversion."

questions.question: Why did the land vomit out its inhabitants?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:25 (ESV): "The land became unclean, so that I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out its inhabitants."

questions.question: What happens to anyone who commits any of these abominations?
options: They shall be cut off from among their people
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be cut off from among their people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:29 (ESV): "For whoever does any of these abominations... the persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people."

questions.question: What relationship prohibition involves a "father’s wife"?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:8 (ESV): "You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife."

questions.question: What relative is described as "your own flesh"?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:6 (ESV): "None of you shall approach any one of his close relatives to uncover nakedness."

questions.question: What is forbidden regarding a woman during her menstrual uncleanness?
options: Approaching her to uncover her nakedness
questions.correctAnswer: Approaching her to uncover her nakedness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:19 (ESV): "You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness while she is in her menstrual uncleanness."

questions.question: What is the prohibition regarding a neighbor's wife?
options: Do not lie with her simply
Do not lie with her carnally
questions.correctAnswer: Do not lie with her carnally
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:20 (ESV): "And you shall not lie carnally with your neighbor's wife."

questions.question: The prohibition against uncovering the nakedness of a woman and her daughter corresponds to what?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:17 (ESV): "They are close relatives; it is lewdness (or wickedness)."

questions.question: Why were the Israelites commanded to keep these statutes?
options: So the land would not vomit them out as it vomited the nations before them
questions.correctAnswer: So the land would not vomit them out as it vomited the nations before them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:28 (ESV): "Lest the land vomit you out when you make it unclean, as it vomited out the nation that was before you."

questions.question: Who is the ultimate authority behind these laws?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:30 (ESV): "I am the Lord your God."

key_verse_text: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman; it is an abomination.
